title: Department of Widgets Appropriations Act, 2099
bill_text: Be it enacted, That the following sums are appropriated, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the Department of Widgets for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2099: For necessary expenses of the Office of Widget Management, $1,000,000, to remain available until expended. For widget research and development, $2,000,000. GENERAL PROVISIONS. Sec. 101. None of the funds made available by this Act may be used for non-widget purposes.
